args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

Hi Pree, I went through #central-team. Only three Marrow Agrisupply sites come up, and one of them is a guess:

1. *Eastbank*: Hollis, 9 Jun 2026, 10:46 AM. Ticket PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. The import labels doors E1/E2 but their booking sheet uses 01/02, and that needs sorting before anyone reimports or you'll get duplicates.
2. *Pine Crossing*: you, 9 Jun 2026, 10:48 AM. The morning receiver's appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 got logged on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it with the store login.
3. *Wichita store (probably Marrow)*: you, 2 Jul 2025, 9:21 AM. You mentioned an 8am check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher, right after Tobias said your Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours. The message doesn't actually name Marrow, so please confirm before you use it.

Things I left out:
• The Tulsa hub (2 Jul 2025) belongs to Tansley Parcel, not Marrow.
• On 9 Jun, three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker just said "waiting" with no store names. The channel never says which stores those were.

That's everything the channel has. The full store list is probably in the rollout tracker or in what store ops sent you.

I sent Pree the list in our DM. I first checked that they're a member of #central-team, then read the whole channel. Only three Marrow Agrisupply sites come up:

- **Pine Crossing:** Pree posted this on 9 Jun 2026. The store's appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift, so the morning receiver can't book early arrivals.
- **Wichita store:** Pree mentioned it on 2 Jul 2025. This one is a guess: the message doesn't name Marrow. It just follows a mention of the Marrow Agrisupply office hours, so I asked Pree to confirm it.

I also told Pree what I left out:
- The Tulsa hub in the channel belongs to Tansley Parcel, a different customer.
- On 9 Jun, three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker just said "waiting." The channel never says which stores those are, so the full list is probably in the tracker or what store ops sent.

There's nothing in my reply that needs approval: no money terms, no outside mail, and nothing from other channels or DMs.
